summary: Website and WordPress specialist with over a decade of experience managing, developing and improving websites for businesses and organisations. Experienced in multi-region WordPress platforms, digital publishing, CMS customisation, website optimisation and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration. Combines strong technical capabilities with a practical understanding of accessibility, SEO, user experience and content management. Skilled at translating business requirements into maintainable digital solutions and supporting non-technical users through intuitive CMS experiences.

bullets: Owned and led end-to-end delivery of bespoke websites and digital products for SMEs, agencies and independent clients, translating business objectives into scalable solutions from discovery and technical planning through UI/UX design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing optimisation.

Designed and developed custom WordPress websites, Shopify storefronts, headless applications and API-driven solutions, selecting technologies for project complexity, performance and long-term maintainability.

Designed responsive, user-centred interfaces in Figma and translated approved designs into production-ready experiences using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, SCSS, ACF, Gutenberg and modern front-end practices.
Engineered bespoke WordPress themes, templates, reusable components, plugins and third-party integrations to extend CMS functionality and streamline content management.
Managed hosting configuration, domains, website migrations, quality assurance, troubleshooting, production releases and post-launch maintenance.
Conducted technical audits and implemented improvements across Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, security and responsive usability.

Owned client relationships and commercial project operations, including consultations, scoping, quotations, invoicing, stakeholder communications and expectation management; coordinated with freelancers and external specialists where required.
Provided ongoing technical consultancy, CMS guidance and post-launch support, advising on digital strategy, platform improvements and future development opportunities.

Owned multi-region, multi-lingual WordPress development and optimisation on WPEngine, improving uptime, scalability and performance for international markets while making content creation and maintenance easier through custom CMS solutions.
Developed, maintained and futureproofed a custom Help Centre enabling partner teams to self-manage content, reducing internal support tickets and improving documentation consistency.
Developed, maintained and scaled custom Gutenberg blocks and page templates using ACF Pro in response to stakeholder requests.
Collaborated with stakeholders in regular team meetings to share website development updates and gather feedback.
Integrated Ninja Forms with Odoo and collaborated with data teams to streamline workflows and improve lead capture accuracy.
Standardised request handling through a Jira-based cross-department workflow, improving clarity and turnaround for ad-hoc requests.
Used AI tools including ChatGPT, Cursor and Copilot to support development and code optimisation, reducing churn and improving quality and performance.
Built and delivered pixel-perfect WordPress builds from Figma with ACF Pro for a B-Corp creative agency, maintaining brand consistency and optimised Lighthouse performance.
Maintained and supported ONQOR’s headless WordPress website with Strapi.
Worked closely with the dedicated design team and attended training sessions to deepen web design knowledge.
Self-taught and built custom Vue.js and Nuxt.js applications during quieter business periods.
Debugged, optimised and refactored legacy builds to reduce client-reported issues.
Completed self-directed projects using Strapi and Nuxt.js to develop modern framework and full-stack skills.
Delivered fast-turnaround WordPress support for 10+ hospitality clients through Zoho Desk, from minor UI fixes to full template redesigns, resolving work in priority order.
Built promotional landing pages at clients’ request.
Used Gulp and Node.js for automated asset optimisation and workflow improvements.
Provided technical improvements for SEO, performance and accessibility.
Worked closely with project managers to streamline ticket handling and reduce resolution times.
Developed and maintained secure, accessible front-end interfaces to public-sector clients’ specifications.
Collaborated with project managers and dedicated proofing teams to deliver client sites on schedule.
Developed and managed the corporate WordPress platform and supported a full branding refresh across digital assets.
Designed and built HubSpot marketing newsletters and landing pages.
Supported marketing with on-brand updates, Adobe XD design mock-ups and voiceovers for explainer videos used on social media.
Owned a portfolio of 3–4 high-traffic gaming websites, improving speed, stability, SEO and UX; designed HubSpot newsletters and landing pages.
Contributed to the Lazerlight Bingo launch, from planning and design alignment through front-end development and post-launch optimisation.
Modernised the front-end stack by migrating Bootstrap 3 to 4 and introducing scalable, maintainable component structures.
Delivered promotional landing pages with the lead designer to support player acquisition and conversions.
Improved team efficiency through reusable front-end patterns, documentation and workflow improvements.
Completed advanced JavaScript training and applied modern techniques to interactivity and performance.

Supported major football, concert and NFL events at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, mainly with the Disability Access Team, providing personalised support to people with cognitive and mobility impairments.

additional.role: Customer Engagement Team Supervisor at Wembley Stadium
bullets: Delivered guest guidance, accessibility assistance and support for premium members in Club Wembley.
Promoted to Supervisor in May 2021, coordinating shifts, managing workflows and supporting smooth operations during high-profile events with a professional, approachable presence.
Supported major public events across London, managing crowd safety, traffic and event operations; engaged directly with attendees and communicated instructions clearly in fast-paced environments.
Represented multiple brands at corporate and hospitality events, delivering front-of-house support and guest engagement while adapting to different client needs and event environments.
